title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy font-src allows plaintext HTTP sources
description: The font-src directive permits plaintext HTTP webfonts, so the glyphs that render the page can be replaced on the wire and the request reveals which page is being read.
applicability: Responses that send Content-Security-Policy with an explicit font-src directive.
risk: A network attacker serves hostile glyphs and learns the page identity from the font request; MEDIUM because it needs the plaintext hop and a page that loads remote fonts.
